description: Plain data table with a header row (e.g. place, state, distance, tags). Scrolls horizontally on narrow screens.

contentPattern.structure: first row is the column headers, then one row per record with one cell per column. Short rows are padded with empty cells

reuseGuidance: Use for any row/column data with a header row. Do not use for layout; use columns for side-by-side content.
